capabilities: Write pressure-sensitive ink on notebook pages
Convert lassoed handwriting to editable text on device
Annotate PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files by hand
Draw on Markdown notes with ink saved beside the file
Create infinite whiteboards and LaTeX formula objects
extras: Free and open source (MIT), no account, telemetry or own server; optional cloud features use your own keys. main.js is about 6.5 MB, above the 5 MB file limit of Obsidian Sync's Standard plan, so the plugin must be installed per device on that plan.
problem: Obsidian has no way to write notes by hand or mark up documents with a pen, so handwritten work and document annotation have to live in other apps.

relations.evidence: The strokes of a selection are sent to MyScript after a confirmation, for text or math.
AI providers (Settings → HandNote → AI): OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud Qwen, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

summary: Handwriting notes on iPad with Apple Pencil: .handnote pages, on-device ink-to-text, and handwritten annotation of PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
